summary: Iter59 — Sponsored / Featured listings end-to-end verification. Backend pytest 10/10 PASSED: public catalogs return featured items first (bs_01, cs_02, tw_01) with is_featured/featured_until/featured_priority fields; admin POST /api/phase2/admin/catalogs/{col}/{id}/feature with duration_days+priority returns 200 and updates featured_until ~N days in future; DELETE removes feature; admin GET /featured lists only featured; auth gates work (401 unauth, 403 non-admin); 404 for non-whitelisted collection and unknown item_id; auto-expiry verified by feature with duration_days=-1 then GET catalogs auto-toggles is_featured=false. Frontend UI 100% PASSED: /beauty /car-care /towing all show sponsored badge (data-testid='sponsored-bs_01' / 'sponsored-cs_02' / 'sponsored-tw_01') visible; /towing first card confirmed 'Dépann\'Express 24/7'; /admin/featured-listings loads with data-testid='admin-featured-page' + 8 collection tabs (tab-beauty_salons … tab-marketplace_listings) + bs_01 shows Retirer button + bs_02 shows Mettre en avant button + clicking feature-bs_02 (window.prompt mocked to 30) → row updates to Sponsorisé and unfeature-bs_02 appears → click → reverts; sidebar 'Mise en avant sponsorisée' entry present.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminFeaturedListings.feature() uses window.prompt() which is blocked in many embedded/iframe contexts and breaks UX; replace with a shadcn Dialog + Input for days selection (testing required prompt-override via add_init_script).

Backend auto-expiry query in /catalogs/{col}: {is_featured:True, featured_until:{$lt: now, $ne: None}} — $ne:None is redundant inside $lt comparison (Mongo $lt:null already excludes null/missing); harmless but worth simplifying. Also fields featured_until/featured_priority are only added once an item is featured — items never featured still return undefined which the frontend handles, OK.

/admin/catalogs/{col}/featured GET endpoint returns featured items but does NOT trigger auto-expiry pass, so an expired-but-not-yet-cleaned item could appear there until the next public /catalogs GET runs. Consider running the same update_many before filtering.
ServiceListLayout.js card click reads any field from the catalog without sanitization — fine for the controlled seed but ensure XSS-safe rendering if admin-editable names land here later.
AdminFeaturedListings.js doesn't validate duration_days input range — user could enter -1 (would create immediately-expired listing) or 99999. Add min=1, max=365 validation.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (3 user routes + admin page + cleanup roundtrip verified)
